tool.name: LangSmith
tool.summary: Enterprise LLMOps platform from LangChain for debugging, testing, evaluating, and monitoring LLM applications and complex agent workflows.
tool.architecture: Distributed telemetry tracing backend with prompt management and online evaluation.
tool.usage:
export LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2="true"
export LANGCHAIN_API_KEY="your-api-key"
# All LangChain & LangGraph calls automatically trace to dashboard
tool.benchmarks: Standard tracing tool for production agent developers.
tool.limitations: Full tracing storage can be expensive at massive enterprise scale.
